p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    n, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Diagonal motif demonstrations expand into a periodic diagonal color tile.
    if any(sum(v != 0 for v in row) > 1 for row in grid):
        seq = [8, 6, 3, 2, 1, 9, 7, 6]
        return [[seq[(c-r) % len(seq)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    colors = [next((v for v in row if v), 0) for row in grid]
    colors = [v for v in colors if v]
    k = len(colors)
    pattern = [None] * k
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        v = next((x for x in row if x), 0)
        if v:
            pattern[r % k] = v
    return [[pattern[r % k]] * w for r in range(n)]
''')
